select kb.ma_kho, kb.ten_kho, kb.ten_kho2, kb.dia_chi, kb.dien_thoai, kb.dien_thoai2, kb.fax, kb.email, kb.web, kb.ma_qg, qg.ten_qg, qg.ten_qg2, kb.ma_kv, kb.status, kb.user_id0, kb.user_id2, kb.datetime0, kb.datetime2, tdx, tdy, ma_ttp, ma_loai, unit_id, hc_yn, kkh_yn, hk_yn, chon_yn from dmkhobai kb, dmquocgia qg where kb.ma_qg = qg.ma_qg;
